arabic text: LAHOO MEIN DOOBE YEH KARBALA HAIN
english translation text: THIS IS KARBALA, SOAKED IN BLOOD

arabic text: LAHOO MEIN DOOBE YEH KARBALA HAIN\nJAVAN LASHO SE DASHTE SARA BHARA HOWA HAI\nHAI YEH KARBALA HAI
english translation text: THIS IS KARBALA, SOAKED IN BLOOD,\nTHE WHOLE DESERT IS FULL OF YOUNG BODIES,\nTHIS IS KARBALA, THIS IS KARBALA.

arabic text:
ALAM JO KAHLI HUSSEIN LAYE
HARAM YEH SAMJEH ABBAS AIYE
HAR EK BASHA ALAM SE RO KAR
LIPAT GAYYA HAIN
english translation text:
WHEN HUSAIN BROUGHT THE A’LAM (FLAG)
ALONE, THE CHILDREN THOUGHT ABBAS
HAD COME, EVERY CHILD CLUNG TO
THE A’LAM (FLAG) AND WEPT.

arabic text:
SAGIR ASGAR KO TEER MARE
CHENE SAKINA KE GOSH VARE
YE KAISE ZULM AUR BHAR BHIRYAAT
KI INTAHA HAI
english translation text:
THEY SHOT THE BABY ALI ASGHAR
WITH AN ARROW, AND SNATCHED AWAY
SAKINA'S EARRINGS FROM HER, THIS IS
THE HEIGHT OF INJUSTICE AND BARBARISM

arabic text:
RABAAB CHEEKI KOIEE TO AIYE
UTHA KE BIMAR KO JO LAYE
KOIEE LUTHERA HAMARE KHAMEIN
JHALLA RAHA HAIN
english translation text:
RUBAB SHOUTED, SOMEONE PLEASE
COME AND CARRY SAJJAD,
WHO IS UNWELL, SOME
VILLAINS ARE BURNING OUR TENTS.

arabic text:
MERI NAVASE BE BERIDA HAIN
MERA NAVASA BHI BE KAFAN HAI
RASOOL RO RO KE AMBIYA KO
BHATA RAHA HAI
english translation text:
'MY GRANDDAUGHTER IS WITHOUT A VEIL,
AND MY GRANDSON IS WITHOUT
A SHROUD', PROPHET (PBUH) IS TELLING
THE OTHER PROPHETS, AND WEEPING.

arabic text:
NA DAIR MAQTAL MAIN AB LAGAWO
CHALLA KEIN GALLDI ASSIR LAWO
LAIYEEN ABID KO TAIZEYANE
LAGA RAHA HAI
english translation text:
DO NOT TAKE LONG IN
THE BATTLEFIELD NOW, WALK QUICKLY
AND BRING THE CAPTIVES, THE
ACCURSED MAN IS WHIPPING SAJJAD.

arabic text:
YE KHOON NE NA HAQ NA CHUP SAKE GA
KABI YE MATAM NA ROK SAKE GA
RUKE TO PHIR KARBALA BANE GE
YE FASILA HAIN
english translation text:
THIS BLOOD THAT WAS SPILT UNJUSTLY WILL NEVER
STAY HIDDEN, THIS MATAM WILL NEVER BE
STOPPED, IF IT IS STOPPED, THEN THERE WILL
BE ANOTHER KARBALA, THIS IS THE DECISION.
